clips.title: The story
paras: Elder Skyseer is the spirit of an ancestral tauren residing atop the towering bluffs of Freewind Post in Thousand Needles. As an honoured elder returned from the spirit world, he observes the ongoing journeys of the Horde and remains deeply tied to the resting grounds of his people.

Perched high above the salt canyons of Thousand Needles, Elder Skyseer lingers at the windswept mesa settlement of Freewind Post. While the tauren of Freewind Post bustle around the outpost's perilous bridges and wooden platforms, Skyseer watches over the realm as an ancestor who has crossed beyond the mortal veil. He serves as an ancestral beacon for travelers seeking the wisdom of past generations, offering his blessings to those who honor old traditions.

Though his spirit commonly manifests among the wind-carved needles, Skyseer belongs to the long line of tauren ancestors whose people honor the sacred soil of Mulgore, where the ancestral spirits of Red Rocks watch over the tribes. Spirits like Skyseer reveal how thin the veil between the physical realm and the ancestral spirits remains for the tauren, guiding future generations through remembrance and ritual.
